change.description: Change the value of a field in the current case. Value returned by the closure will be used as the new value.

params.name: field
params.description: Reference to process data field. The local variable from the action reference mapping can be used.

params.name: closure
params.description: Groovy closure which returned object is set as new value of the data field.

examples: change enum_field value { def keys = enum_field.options.keySet(); return keys.first() }
